canonicalJson: UTF-8 without escapes, sorted keys, 2-space indent, LF, one trailing newline, numbers to at most three decimals
description: Fixtures for the Plannotation 0.1 document-level index schema. Every document under valid/ must validate against schema; every document under invalid/ must fail with exactly one error, of the stated keyword, at the stated errorPath (python-jsonschema json_path syntax). schemaPointer is a JSON Pointer that dereferences to the failing keyword in the schema file; validatorSchemaPath is the same rule as python-jsonschema renders it, with $ref hops elided -- the index schema carries no $ref, so the two agree. Every index here describes the page labels in tests/fixtures/plannotations: each entry's sheetId, title, revision and pageIndex are copied from that sheet's label fixture, its level is the level conformance_level() computes for that label, and its file is the attachment name plannotation_filename() produces for that page index.

invalid.description: A page graded L4, a conformance level the format does not define.
invalid.violates: properties.pages.items.properties.level.enum -- the only conformance levels are L1, L2 and L3

invalid.description: A page index written as the string "3", as a writer that templated the index as text would emit it.
invalid.violates: properties.pages.items.properties.pageIndex.type -- the page index is an integer, never its decimal spelling

invalid.description: A page entry that names the sheet but never says which level its label reaches.
invalid.violates: properties.pages.items.required -- every page entry carries pageIndex, sheetId and level

covers: page entry with required members only
valid.description: The smallest legal index: the version token and one page entry carrying nothing but pageIndex, sheetId and level. It indexes the minimal page label.

covers: page entries with title, revision and file
file names as plannotation_filename produces them
levels L1, L2 and L3 one per page
valid.description: The architectural package written from one IFC4 model: every optional top-level member is present, and every optional member of every page entry.

covers: no model block, because the pages come from three models
conformance levels mixed across pages: L1, L2 and L3
pages of four disciplines on one document
valid.description: The combined issue set: nine labelled pages from four disciplines, spanning all three conformance levels and all three provenances, so the index aggregates to mixed and names no single source model.
